title: Anthropic · 更新日志来源更新
summary: Claude Managed Agents sessions that run in a self-hosted sandbox can now attach memory stores. The Python, TypeScript, and Go SDK workers download each attached store into the sandbox at its mount_path and sync the agent's changes back to the store. See Memory stores in self-hosted sandboxes.
